title.narrative: Strengthen the Engagement of Supreme Audit Institutions and CSOs in Improving PFM (CADRE)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to improve government accountability in the use and management of public resources. Countries involved are Zambia and Malawi. By facilitating collaboration between CSOs and SAIs, through capacity building (component 1) and joint communication, advocacy and citizen participation activities (component 2), the project will promote transparency, accountability and control in the management of public resources. It will strengthen the watchdog role of CSOs and CSIs as actors in holding government institutions responsible and accountable for their financial activities. The result will be greater transparency and effective accountability in the allocation, management and spending of public resources. Objective 1: To strengthen the capacity of CSOs and SAIs to collaborate effectively in order to contribute to the improvement of PFM in Zambia and Malawi, taking into account gender considerations and social inclusion.Objective 2: Implement joint communication/awareness-raising and advocacy initiatives to strengthen external control and transparency of public financial management (PFM). Value of the contract is EUR 292,516.

activity-date.narrative: The planned end date has changed from October to June 2026

recipient-region.narrative: The countries involved are Malawi and Zambia.
